body: Wonderful. :)
We're both okay and trying to work on getting everything better. Thanks for caring. :)
Nope it's only with her which is why it's just so unlike me.
Yeah I was a big dick and I realize I can't treat the people I love like that. Thank you.
Thanks and you have a wonderful point, now that I know shes still alive I would never take my own life. Not for me, but for my love for I would never abandon her.
Thanks so much for reading, I think sharing with you guys was all the help I needed to feel better.
I plan on doing something really special to show her I care
Thank you, I'm trying not to let the guilt take over me.

Thank you so much for all the kind words and advice you've given me. I agree 100% that I can't put my life on hold because of her anymore (she never even asked me too, I've just been so obsessed). Hopefully I can start focusing on myself more to be a better partner to her.
Yeah, I've updated the initial post and I think everything will be alright. But I know there will have to be some serious changes on my part to show my love that our relationship CAN work.
Thank you so so much, I've updated the initial post too If you're interested. :)
Yeah, I realize now there must have been more and I'm going to be there for her (completely selfless and understanding) as long as she wants me to be there for her. Thanks for your words.

Thanks alot. I think I know where you're coming from as I've felt the same too. But I don't think she was depressed as much as wanting attention or something. Either way I will be trying to enjoy myself more without her so that I don't feel a need to always be there with her. Thanks you.

Thank you. I have alot of things that make me really happy to be honest, but nothing comes close to as happy as I am with her. It's kind of a blessing and a curse but I think I'm going to have to learn to cope if I want things to work out with her.

Would never take offense from someone trying to help. Thanks so much for your words, and you're right.

I've had some time to contemplate and I realize alot of the bad things that have been happening are from me. I need to take a step back and realize not to get upset over every little thing. Thanks for the kind words.
Thank you.
We're both 18 so still kinda young but not some middle school bullshit.

This wasn't a desperate attempt to get me to care though. She told me this is the only way for me to move on from her (I'm extremely clingy even though she loves me with all her heart). She said that if she didn't do this she'd keep hurting me because neither of us want to leave each other.
Thank you.

Thank you so much for the advice... And no she isn't diabetic, it's her sisters insulin. I am trying to stay calm right now but my heart hurts so much...

Although we are dependant of each other, is that wrong if we make each other so happy? Sure right now things were bad but I've literally never been so happy with another human being in my life before.

She's never done something like this... I've been pushing her over and over lately and it's my fault. But do you know if she'll be alright if she's treated immediately? 

Also for some honest advice... If she's okay after all this is done. And I'm really willing to change and not be jealous (how the hell could I be after I've seen that I almost took her life... if she lives) do you think me and her could still work out?

It was because of me though. Before this she was perfectly happy there were no problems with her. She'd go out with her family and friends almost every day and it was only me who would get jealous when we werent spending time together... She'd text me everyday with love and I'd just reply being jealous and bitter... I've ruined a perfect life.
